body: Druski went crazy to “Ran To Atlanta” with Future @future in the club for his birthday The record is Drake @champagnepapi featuring Future and Molly Santana, track 5 on Iceman. Dropped May 15, 2026. First Drake and Future collab since 2022. It debuted at No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100, No. 2 on the Global 200, No. 2 in Canada, and No. 2 on Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs. Hit No. S. 4 million streams in a day. Sitting around 131 million Spotify streams now. That’s the clip.

source_caption_text:
Druski went crazy to “Ran To Atlanta” with Future in the club for his birthday 😂🔥🔥

The record is Drake featuring Future and Molly Santana, track 5 on Iceman. Dropped May 15, 2026. First Drake and Future collab since 2022.

It debuted at No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100, No. 2 on the Global 200, No. 2 in Canada, and No. 2 on Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs. Hit No. 1 on U.S. Spotify with 2.4 million streams in a day. Sitting around 131 million Spotify streams now.

That’s the clip. Future in the building. Druski on the song. Club record doing club numbers.
